name: Golden egg fried rice
description: A quick skillet meal with fluffy egg, rice, and crisp vegetables.
steps: Chop the onion and carrot. Beat the eggs in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a skillet. Cook the onion and carrot until softened, then add the peas.
Push vegetables to one side. Add the eggs and scramble until fully set.
Add the cooked rice and soy sauce. Stir until everything is piping hot. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken & vegetable rice bowl
description: A balanced bowl of tender chicken, warm rice, and broccoli.
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Chop the vegetables.
Heat the oil and cook the chicken with garlic until it reaches 74°C / 165°F internally.
Add the broccoli and carrot with a splash of water and cook until tender.
Reheat the cooked rice until piping hot. Divide into bowls and top with chicken, vegetables, and lemon juice.

name: Tomato & garlic pasta
description: A simple tomato sauce, a little garlic, and a comforting bowl of pasta.
steps: Boil the pasta in water according to its package directions.
Chop tomatoes and onion. Gently cook the onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the pasta, saving a little cooking water. Toss with the sauce, loosening with cooking water if needed.

name: Bright chickpea salad
description: A fresh, satisfying bowl with chickpeas, crunchy cucumber, and lemon.
steps: Use cooked, cooled chickpeas. Rinse and drain if using canned chickpeas.
Chop the cucumber, tomatoes, and onion into small pieces.
Whisk the olive oil with lemon juice.
Toss everything together and divide between two bowls.

name: Spinach & mushroom omelet
description: A protein-rich breakfast with soft vegetables and a golden egg fold.
steps: Slice the mushrooms and wash the spinach. Beat the eggs.
Heat oil in a non-stick skillet and cook the mushrooms. Add spinach until wilted.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until set, lifting the edges so uncooked egg reaches the pan.
Sprinkle with cheese, fold, and cook until no liquid egg remains.

name: Warm lentil & roasted vegetable bowl
description: Hearty lentils and colorful vegetables, finished with a lemon dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C / 390°F. Chop the vegetables.
Toss the vegetables with olive oil and roast for 20–25 minutes until tender.
Warm the cooked lentils with a splash of water.
Combine lentils and vegetables. Finish with lemon juice and divide between two bowls.

name: Banana & almond overnight oats
description: A make-ahead breakfast with creamy oats, banana, and almonds.
steps: Mix oats, milk, and yogurt in a covered container.
Refrigerate overnight or for at least four hours. The listed preparation time excludes chilling.
Slice the banana and roughly chop the almonds.
Stir the oats and add the banana and almonds before serving.

name: Rustic potato & egg skillet
description: Golden potatoes, sweet onion, and eggs in a simple one-pan meal.
steps: Dice the potatoes and onion. Parboil potatoes for 5–7 minutes, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and fry the potato and onion until golden and tender.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for a few minutes.
Make small wells and add eggs. Cover and cook until whites and yolks are fully set.

name: Tofu & broccoli rice bowl
description: A plant-based skillet bowl with firm tofu and crisp broccoli.
steps: Drain and cube the tofu. Chop broccoli into small florets.
Heat olive oil and brown the tofu on both sides.
Add garlic and broccoli with a splash of water; cover briefly until tender.
Add soy sauce. Reheat cooked rice until piping hot and serve with the tofu and broccoli.

name: Tuna & sweetcorn pasta salad
description: An easy, satisfying pasta salad with tuna, corn, and crunchy vegetables.
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions. Cool promptly under cold water and drain.
Cook the sweetcorn until tender and cool. Drain the canned tuna.
Dice the cucumber and mix yogurt with lemon juice.
Combine all ingredients. Serve promptly or refrigerate in a covered container.

name: Simple red bean chili
description: A warming tomato and bean bowl with plenty of vegetables.
steps: Use fully cooked kidney beans; this recipe does not prepare dried raw beans.
Chop vegetables. Cook onion and garlic in olive oil until softened.
Add pepper and tomatoes. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the cooked beans and heat thoroughly. Serve in bowls; season to taste and log any extra ingredients separately.

name: Avocado & egg toast
description: Creamy avocado and a cooked egg on whole-wheat bread.
steps: Toast the whole-wheat bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice.
Heat olive oil and cook the egg until the white and yolk are fully set.
Spread avocado on toast and top with the egg. Add any extras to your nutrition log.

name: Spanish-style potato omelette
description: Tender potatoes and onion folded into a simple egg omelette.
steps: Thinly slice potato and onion. Cook in oil over medium-low heat until the potato is tender.
Beat the eggs, combine with the vegetables, and return to the pan.
Cook gently until the eggs are fully set, flipping carefully or finishing under a grill. Divide into two servings.

name: Quick potato & egg tomato stew
description: A warm one-pan potato and egg meal; add curry spices if you have them.
steps: Dice potatoes and onion. Soften onion in oil, then add tomatoes and potato.
Add a splash of water, cover, and simmer until the potatoes are tender. Optional curry spices are not included in the nutrition estimate.
Crack in the eggs, cover, and cook until whites and yolks are fully set. Divide into two servings.
